summary: Confirmed $46 nightly for trailers/RVs with water and electric (2025 rates), phone 518-762-1946, reservable online. Corrected max length 60 -> 55 ft (ResNexus) and added 50-amp (site 5), pull-throughs, showers, Wi-Fi, ResNexus booking URL; cleared the note-derived Nov 30 closing (the park says it is already closed for the season). Note: dropped site count/length/booking/season/RV Life text and the stale 'Spot2Nite' booking claim. Long-stay five tests pass (below).
flags: Long-stay five tests (about 30 of ~50 sites seasonal per the note; not stated on the operator pages): (1) $46 nightly is under US$50; (2) nights really for sale: a posted nightly rate, phone, and ResNexus selling single nights with no application; (3) no minimum stated; (4) ResNexus lists 11 RV sites nightly (4-13, 16), over 1 in 10; (5) no homes or lots for sale. Passes; 2-week ($575) and monthly ($1,210) rates are also posted.

Waterfront re-audit lead (contrary booking-engine claim): ResNexus lists a 'Waterfront cabin' (pond view) and pull-through 'Site 16 ... by the pond', against 'not waterfront' (the water is the park's stocked fishing pond).
Stale operator page: royalmountaincampground.com's rates page is headed '2025 Camping Rates' and its footer reads 2017-2023; no 2026 rate is posted.
